name: Google Agent Development Kit Runtime
mechanism: Uses a stateless runner over session, artifact and memory services with event persistence, tools, plugins and sequential, parallel, loop and LLM agents.
use_when: The application needs modular sessions, events, tools and multi-agent patterns
Google ecosystem integration is useful but model and deployment adapters remain explicit
avoid_when: A very small control loop would avoid the service abstractions
Cross-provider parity, residency or non-Google deployment has not been tested
expected_effects: Structured event and session lifecycle around a stateless runner
Reusable plugins, tools and multi-agent orchestration patterns
failure_modes: In-memory services are carried into production without durability
Ecosystem-optimized defaults create practical provider or hosting lock-in
Session compaction loses evidence needed for later decisions
